## Change

Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior. Link the related issue.

## Validation

List meaningful checks run and their results. State any deployment/native checks
still pending. For permission changes, include denied cross-organization and
privilege-escalation cases. Use synthetic users and disposable PostgreSQL.

## Compatibility

Describe API/schema, encrypted identity, Docker or operator migration changes.
Remove this section when there are none. Never include credentials or user data.
